notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
The demo has been translated to simplified and traditional Chinese.



Bug fixes include:

Preventing overflow of text

Timescale issues when using certain gadgets and opening blocking UI at the same time

Fixed enemies not detecting player again after loosing detection of player once

Fixed dialogue of pirate stations not being displayed in the right order

Fixed main menu buttons being displayed while settings are still open after changing resolution

Fixed enemies spawning initially even though player is too far away

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Bug fixes
NPC Dialogue is now displayed correctly

Bug that let players get stuck in black holes is fixed

Bug that let players move through walls inside the hidden vaults is fixed

Bombs in planets and gadget bomb now destroy tiles in a certain radius

Resources dropped by lootboxes when the players storage is already full can now be collected again


Improved User Experience
UI Element that displays the current amount of XP

An additional button for flying more slowly, allowing for more control

Enemies loose detection of the player at a certain distance

Tutorial dialogue explaining how charges work was rephrased to be clearer 

Projectiles are now slower

Dialogue can now be skipped using E instead of left mouse button to allow one-handed control 

Backgrounds of planets are now darker to make them more distinguishable
